title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper HP-MDR: High-performance and Portable Data Refactoring and Progressive Retrieval with Advanced GPUs
problem: Reproducibility of GPU-accelerated data refactoring requires independent artifact evaluation.
motivation: SC25 Reproducibility Initiative validates published results through independent evaluation.
method: The researchers independently ran the HP-MDR code on GPUs using the authors' original experimental setup to check if they got the same results. This process—called artifact evaluation—verifies that the reported speedups for data refactoring (reorganizing data structures for faster access on GPUs) actually occur when others run the experiments. The evaluation confirms both that the experimental conditions were set up correctly and that the measured performance matches what was originally published.
key_novelty: This work independently verifies whether the reported HP-MDR results for GPU data refactoring are reproducible.
contributions: Artifact evaluation of data refactoring with advanced GPUs
Documentation of SC25 Reproducibility Initiative work
limitations: Reproducibility report only; limited details without access to full original paper content
